caseName: Bailey v. Oregon-Washington Railroad & Navigation Co.
caseNameFull: Virginia Bailey v. Oregon-Washington Railroad & Navigation Company
attorneys: Mr. Thomas Mannix and Mr. George Arthur Brown for plaintiffs in error. Mr. H. W. Clark, Mr. A. C. Spencer and Mr. John F. Reilly for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. § 237, Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
